title: Hedging and Diplomacy in Academic Discussion / Lokola na elaka na mibeko ya akademike
bridge: Na anglais akademike, lokola (hedging) ezali mbongo mpenza po na kosalela motoya oyo ezali ya kritikeli kasi ya elaka. Na ndakisa ya espagnol, tozali kobimisa na esika ya kosalela subjonctif po na kopesa nguya (m.e. 'Peut-être que c'est vrai'), anglais azali kosalela mpe na verbes modaux (might, may, could) mpe na adverbes ya probabilite mpe verbes ya opinion. Likolo ya malamu ezali kosalela motoya oyo ezali ya ndenge moko na ya espagnol 'Eso no es correcto', oyo na anglais ezali kobima; na ndakisa, tokolakisa 'That might not be entirely accurate'. Likolo moko ezali kosalela 'suggest' mpo na 'sugerir' na esika ya kopesa molongo, kasi na anglais 'suggest' ezali mpe na esika ya kopesa molongo mpe na esika ya kosalela elaka.
rule: Lokola na anglais akademike ezali kosalema na: 1) Verbes modaux ya possibilite: might, may, could (m.e. 'This might indicate...'). 2) Verbes ya opinion na liboso ya motoya: I would argue, I tend to think, I feel. 3) Adverbes ya frequence/probabilite: perhaps, possibly, arguably, seemingly, apparently. 4) Verbes ya rapport (reporting verbs) oyo ezali kopesa nguya: suggests, indicates, implies, appears (na esika ya 'proves' to 'shows'). 5) Structures impersonelles: it could be argued that, it seems that, one might consider. 6) Negation na ba adjectifs: not entirely, not necessarily, not wholly (m.e. 'not entirely convincing'). 7) Kosalela 'somewhat', 'rather', 'fairly' liboso ya ba adjectifs (m.e. 'somewhat controversial'). 8) Conditionnels po na ba hypothese: if this were the case, it would... Regles ya mbongo: kosalela te 'must' to 'definitely' na mibeko ya akademike (ezali kobima); kosalela te mpenza 'very' (salela 'highly', 'considerably'); mpe kosala na mokolo 'creo que' ezali na ndenge moko na 'I think' na anglais, kasi na mibeko ya akademike tozali kobimisa 'I would argue' to 'It seems to me'. Ba exceptions: na ba conclusions tozali kobima mpenza (m.e. 'This demonstrates...'), kasi mpe na esika ya kopesa nguya na 'strongly suggests'.

concept_examples.text: It could be argued that the author's conclusion is somewhat premature.
concept_examples.translation: Tokoki kolakisa ete conclusion ya auteur ezali ya ndenge moko na ya prematurite.
concept_examples.phonetic: ɪt kʊd bi ˈɑːrɡjuːd ðæt ði ˈɔːθərz kənˈkluːʒən ɪz ˈsʌmwʌt ˌpriːməˈtjʊr.

concept_examples.text: This evidence might suggest a different interpretation of the data.
concept_examples.translation: Ba preuves ya ndenge wana tokoki kolakisa interpretation moko ya ndenge moko na ba données.
concept_examples.phonetic: ðɪs ˈɛvɪdəns maɪt səˈdʒɛst ə ˈdɪfərənt ɪntərprɪˈteɪʃən əv ðə ˈdeɪtə.

concept_examples.text: I would argue that the methodology is not entirely valid.
concept_examples.translation: Nakoti kolakisa ete méthodologie ezali ya ndenge moko na ya validite.
concept_examples.phonetic: aɪ wʊd ˈɑːrɡjuː ðæt ðə ˌmɛθəˈdɒlədʒi ɪz nɒt ɪnˈtaɪərli ˈvælɪd.

concept_examples.text: One might consider the possibility of a sampling bias.
concept_examples.translation: Tokoki kosala na mokolo ete ezali na likambo ya biais ya échantillonnage.
concept_examples.phonetic: wʌn maɪt kənˈsɪdər ðə ˌpɒsəˈbɪlɪti əv ə ˈsæmplɪŋ ˈbaɪəs.

common_error.wrong: That's not true, you are wrong.
common_error.correct: That might not be entirely accurate.
common_error.correct_alt: I would respectfully disagree with that point.
common_error.explanation: Likolo ezali kotika na esika ya kopesa motoya ya ndenge moko na ya espagnol 'Eso no es cierto, estás equivocado'. Na mibeko ya akademike ya anglais, motoya oyo ezali ya ndenge moko na ya agressivité mpe ya manque ya professionnalisme. Na espagnol mpe, tozali kobimisa elaka, kasi structure ya grammaire ezali kopesa nguya ya kosalela motoya oyo ezali ya ndenge moko. Po na kosala ndenge wana, na anglais tozali kosalela lokola: tozali kopesa nguya na 'might not' mpe tozali kosalela te 'you are wrong' kasi tozali kolakisa idée ('not accurate'). Ndakisa moko ezali kosalela conditionnel 'would' mpe verbe 'disagree' na adverb moko ya ndenge moko na 'respectfully'.

levels.label: Modal Verbs for Hedging
levels.translation: Ba verbes modaux po na lokola

examples.original: This theory might explain the observed phenomena.
examples.phonetic: ðɪs ˈθɪəri maɪt ɪkˈspleɪn ði əbˈzɜːvd fəˈnɒmɪnə.
examples.translation: Théorie oyo tokoki kolakisa ba phénomènes oyo tozali kosala.
examples.note: Tozali kosalela 'might' po na possibilite ya ndenge moko. Na espagnol tozali kosalela 'podría', kasi tokoki kosala na mokolo ete ezali na ndenge moko na 'may' oyo ezali ya ndenge moko na ya formel.

examples.original: The results could be interpreted in several ways.
examples.phonetic: ðə rɪˈzʌlts kʊd bi ɪnˈtɜːprɪtɪd ɪn ˈsɛvrəl weɪz.
examples.translation: Ba résultats tokoki kosalema na ba ndenge moko.
examples.note: 'Could' ezali kolakisa ba options, te certitude. Na espagnol verbe 'poder' ezali kosalema na ba ndenge moko, kasi na anglais 'could' ezali ya ndenge moko na ya hypothétique na ndenge ya 'can'.

examples.original: These findings may indicate a need for further research.
examples.phonetic: ðiːz ˈfaɪndɪŋz meɪ ˈɪndɪkeɪt ə niːd fɔː ˈfɜːðər rɪˈsɜːtʃ.
examples.translation: Ba découvertes oyo tokoki kolakisa necessite ya recherche ya sika.
examples.note: 'May' ezali ya ndenge moko na ya courant na écriture akademike po na kolakisa implication moko. Na espagnol, 'pueden' ezali kosalema te mpenza na contexte oyo; mbala moke tozali kobimisa 'sugieren'.

levels.label: Reporting Verbs and Impersonal Structures
levels.translation: Ba verbes ya rapport mpe structures impersonnelles

examples.original: The study suggests a correlation between sleep and memory.
examples.phonetic: ðə ˈstʌdi səˈdʒɛsts ə ˌkɒrəˈleɪʃən bɪˈtwiːn sliːp ænd ˈmɛməri.
examples.translation: Etude ezali kolakisa correlation moko entre sommeil mpe mémoire.
examples.note: Na espagnol tozali kosalela 'sugiere' kasi na anglais ezali ya ndenge moko na 'muestra'. Kosalela te 'proves' na contexte ya akademike.

examples.original: It could be argued that the sample size was insufficient.
examples.phonetic: ɪt kʊd bi ˈɑːrɡjuːd ðæt ðə ˈsæmpl saɪz wɒz ˌɪnsəˈfɪʃənt.
examples.translation: Tokoki kolakisa ete taille ya échantillon ezali ya ndenge moko na ya insuffisant.
examples.note: Structure impersonnelle oyo ezali ya mbongo. Na espagnol tozali kosalela 'se podría argumentar', kasi ba locuteurs moke tozali kobenga 'it' mpe tozali kolakisa 'podría argumentarse', oyo ezali ya ndenge moko na ya incorrect na anglais.

examples.original: It seems that the data are inconsistent with the hypothesis.
examples.phonetic: ɪt siːmz ðæt ðə ˈdeɪtə ɑːr ˌɪnkənˈsɪstənt wɪð ðə haɪˈpɒθɪsɪs.
examples.translation: Ezali mpo na kolakisa ete données ezali ya ndenge moko na ya cohérence na hypothèse.
examples.note: 'It seems that' ezali lokola ya ndenge moko. Na espagnol tozali kolakisa 'parece que', kasi na anglais structure ezali na sujet 'it'.

levels.label: Softening Adjectives and Adverbs
levels.translation: Ba adjectifs mpe adverbes ya lokola

examples.original: The argument is not entirely convincing.
examples.phonetic: ði ˈɑːrɡjumənt ɪz nɒt ɪnˈtaɪərli kənˈvɪnsɪŋ.
examples.translation: Argument ezali ya ndenge moko na ya convaincant.
examples.note: Na espagnol tozali kosalela 'no del todo', mpe na anglais 'not entirely' ezali ya ndenge moko. Kosalela te 'not very' oyo ezali ya ndenge moko na ya faible.

examples.original: This approach is rather problematic.
examples.phonetic: ðɪs əˈprəʊtʃ ɪz ˈrɑːðər ˌprɒbləˈmætɪk.
examples.translation: Approche oyo ezali ya ndenge moko na ya problématique.
examples.note: 'Rather' na contexte oyo ezali kolakisa 'bastante' mpe ezali kopesa nguya ya critique. Na espagnol 'bastante' tokoki kosalela na ndenge moko na ya fort, kasi na anglais 'rather' ezali ya ndenge moko na ya diplomatique na ndenge ya 'very'.

examples.original: The results are somewhat surprising.
examples.phonetic: ðə rɪˈzʌlts ɑːr ˈsʌmwʌt səˈpraɪzɪŋ.
examples.translation: Ba résultats ezali ya ndenge moko na ya surprenant.
examples.note: 'Somewhat' ezali ya ndenge moko na 'algo' to 'un poco', kasi na anglais tozali kosalela mpenza na ndenge ya formel. Salela yango po na kopesa nguya ya ba affirmations.

title: Strategic Hedging & Diplomatic Language / Liyébisi ya stratéjika na nsango ya diplómátíkó
bridge: Na español, mbala nyingi basili kotonga makambo na bango na nzela ya komona yango na bango mpe na nsango ya 'quizás', 'a lo mejor' to na subjuntivo, kasi na anglais ya mibeko, basali na bango na nsango ya mpeve ya modalité (ntango, perhaps, arguably) mpe na 'hedging verbs' lokola 'seem', 'appear', 'tend to'. Likama ya moke ya bato ya español ezali koteya makambo na bango na ntina mpenza (ntango, 'This is wrong') to kopesa yango na nzela ya 'It is possible that...' ndenge anglais ya mibeko ezali kobenga yango na nzela ya modalité ya moke mpe ya mawa. Mpe, nsango ya 'I think' ezali ya mawa mpenza na anglais ya britannique ya mibeko koleka 'I believe', likambo oyo ezali na esika nyonso na ndenge ya español ya kosala 'creo' na nzela ya mawa.
rule: Na anglais ya mibeko, 'hedging' (kotonga) ezali kosalema na: 1) Mpeve ya modalité: perhaps, possibly, arguably, presumably, allegedly (na ye ya liboso to na ye ya mokolo). 2) Mpeve ya kosepela: seem, appear, tend to, suggest (basili koteya makambo na bango na ntina mpenza). 3) Modalité: might, may, could (mawa koleka 'must' to 'will'). 4) Nsango lokola 'It could be argued that...', 'One might say that...' (basili koteya makambo na bango na ntina mpenza). 5) Nkombo: 'a bit', 'slightly', 'somewhat' (basali koyoka makambo na bango). Mbala moke: na español basali na subjuntivo mpo na kopesa makambo na bango, kasi na anglais basali na modalité + forme ya liboso (mpe na -s te). Ntango: 'Es posible que esté equivocado' → 'It is possible that I am wrong' (te 'I be wrong'). Na mitungisi, basali na 'I'd suggest we consider...' na esika ya 'We should change...'. Mpo na kopesa makambo na bango na nzela ya mawa: 'I see your point, but have we considered...?' (basali koyoka 'No, that's wrong'). Niveau C1 ezali na makambo ya moke: 'I'm not entirely convinced that...' vs. 'I have reservations about...'.

concept_examples.text: Perhaps we could revisit the proposal with a more flexible timeline.
concept_examples.translation: Ntango ezali se, tozali koyeba proposition na calendrier moke ya mawa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /pərˈhæps wiː kʊd riːˈvɪzɪt ðə prəˈpoʊzəl wɪð ə mɔːr ˈfleksəbl ˈtaɪmlaɪn/

concept_examples.text: It seems that the market trends are shifting toward sustainable solutions.
concept_examples.translation: Ezali lokola ete tendance ya marché ezali kokende na esika ya mawa ya solution ya mawa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪt siːmz ðæt ðə ˈmɑːrkɪt trendz ɑːr ˈʃɪftɪŋ təˈwɔːrd səˈsteɪnəbl səˈluːʃənz/

concept_examples.text: One could argue that the risks have been underestimated.
concept_examples.translation: Tozali koyeba ete risque ezali koyokana na esika ya mawa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wʌn kʊd ˈɑːrɡjuː ðæt ðə rɪsks hæv biːn ˌʌndərˈestɪmeɪtɪd/

concept_examples.text: I'm not entirely convinced that this approach yields the expected results.
concept_examples.translation: Nazali na makambo ya moke ya koyeba ete ndenge oyo ezali koyeba makambo ya mawa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪm nɑːt ɪnˈtaɪərli kənˈvɪnst ðæt ðɪs əˈproʊtʃ jiːldz ði ɪkˈspektɪd rɪˈzʌlts/

common_error.wrong: I think that this is a bad idea.
common_error.correct: I'm not entirely convinced that this is the most effective approach.
common_error.correct_alt: I have some reservations about this approach.
common_error.explanation: Likama ezali na nsango ya 'I think' + nkombo ya mawa mpe ya mawa, oyo ezali koyokana na anglais ya mibeko. Bato ya español basali koyeba makambo na bango na ntina mpenza 'creo que es una mala idea', kasi na anglais basali koyeba makambo na bango na nzela ya mawa oyo ezali koyokana na makambo ya mawa. Mpo na koyoka yango, sala na nsango lokola 'I'm not entirely convinced', 'I have reservations', to 'Have you considered...?'. Mpe, 'I think' ezali koyokana na makambo ya mawa; na contexte ya mibeko, basali na 'I believe' to 'I would argue'.

examples.original: Could you possibly send me the report by tomorrow?
examples.phonetic: /kʊd juː ˈpɑːsəbli send miː ðə rɪˈpɔːrt baɪ təˈmɑːroʊ/
examples.translation: Boye ozali koyeba rapport mpo na demain?
examples.note: Sala na 'could' + 'possibly' mpo na koyokana na makambo ya mawa koleka 'can'.

examples.original: I would appreciate it if you could review this document at your earliest convenience.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd əˈpriːʃieɪt ɪt ɪf juː kʊd rɪˈvjuː ðɪs ˈdɑːkjumənt æt jʊr ˈɜːrliɪst kənˈviːniəns/
examples.translation: Nazali koyeba ete ozali koyeba document oyo na mawa mpe na mawa.
examples.note: Structure ya mibeko na 'would appreciate' + 'if' + passé ya mawa.

examples.original: Would you mind taking a quick look at the proposal?
examples.phonetic: /wʊd juː maɪnd ˈteɪkɪŋ ə kwɪk lʊk æt ðə prəˈpoʊzəl/
examples.translation: Ozali koyeba ete ozali koyeba proposition oyo na mawa?
examples.note: 'Would you mind' na gerundif (-ing) ezali formule ya mawa.

examples.original: I see your point, but have we considered the financial implications?
examples.phonetic: /aɪ siː jʊr pɔɪnt bʌt hæv wiː kənˈsɪdərd ðə faɪˈnænʃəl ˌɪmplɪˈkeɪʃənz/
examples.translation: Nazali koyeba ete ozali koyeba makambo ya mawa, kasi tozali koyeba makambo ya mawa ya mibeko?
examples.note: Tala makambo ya mawa ya moke liboso ya koyokana na makambo ya mawa.

examples.original: I'm not entirely sure that aligns with our current strategy.
examples.phonetic: /aɪm nɑːt ɪnˈtaɪərli ʃʊr ðæt əˈlaɪnz wɪð aʊr ˈkɜːrənt ˈstrætədʒi/
examples.translation: Nazali na makambo ya moke ya koyeba ete oyo ezali koyokana na stratégie ya mawa.
examples.note: Sala na 'not entirely sure' mpo na koyoka 'no' ya mawa.

examples.original: With all due respect, I think there might be another angle to explore.
examples.phonetic: /wɪð ɔːl duː rɪˈspekt aɪ θɪŋk ðer maɪt biː əˈnʌðər ˈæŋɡl tə ɪkˈsplɔːr/
examples.translation: Na respect nyonso, nazali koyeba ete tozali koyeba makambo ya mawa ya moke.
examples.note: Nsango ya 'with all due respect' ezali koyokana na makambo ya mawa.

examples.original: The data appears to suggest a slight upward trend in sales.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈdeɪtə əˈpɪrz tə səˈdʒest ə slaɪt ˈʌpwərd trend ɪn seɪlz/
examples.translation: Données ezali koyeba ete ezali na makambo ya mawa ya moke ya mawa.
examples.note: Sala na 'appears to' + 'suggest' mpo na koyoka makambo na bango na ntina mpenza te.

examples.original: It could be argued that the current model is somewhat outdated.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt kʊd biː ˈɑːrɡjuːd ðæt ðə ˈkɜːrənt ˈmɑːdl ɪz ˈsʌmwʌt ˌaʊtˈdeɪtɪd/
examples.translation: Tozali koyeba ete modèle oyo ezali na makambo ya mawa ya moke.
examples.note: Structure ya mawa: 'It could be argued that' + affirmation.

examples.original: This might not be the optimal solution, but it's a viable starting point.
examples.phonetic: /ðɪs maɪt nɑːt biː ði ˈɑːptɪməl səˈluːʃən bʌt ɪts ə ˈvaɪəbl ˈstɑːrtɪŋ pɔɪnt/
examples.translation: Oyo ezali se ezali solution ya mawa, kasi ezali na makambo ya mawa ya moke.
examples.note: Contraste na 'but' mpo na koyokana na critique na proposition.

translations.ln: Komunikasyon ya mibeko ya niveau ya mawa

title: Nuanced Literary Analysis: Register, Tone, and Implied Meaning / Analisi ya matisé ya littéraire: Registre, Ton, na nguya ya sous-entendu
bridge: Na español, tokolí koluka kotanga makasi na ba structure ya subjonctif mpe na ba moyen ya rhétorique ya clair po kosalela ba nuance ya avis to analyse. Na anglais, niveau C1 ekomema kotosa modalité na ba verbe modal (might, could, would), kotambola na voix passive po kopesa distance, mpe kotambola na vocabulaire ya évaluation ya précis. Ba lokómi na español bazali kopesa ba structure ya genre ya 'es posible que...' na 'it is possible that...' na ndenge ya mot à mot, kasi anglais ezwamaka na ba nuance na ba adverbe (arguably, ostensibly) to na ba verbe modal, mpe ekoki kosala attention na kotambola na présent historique mpe past perfect po kosala histoire mpe analyse ya ba œuvre littéraire.
rule:
Po na analyse littéraire mpe culturel na niveau C1 na anglais, tokoki kosalela:
1. **Registre formel mpe académique**: Kotambola na ba verbe ya genre ya *suggest, imply, illustrate, portray* na esika ya *show* to *tell*, mpe ba connecteur discursif (however, moreover, consequently).
2. **Modalité po kosalela ba degré ya certitude**: *Must* po na ba déduction logique, *might/may* po na ba possibilité, mpe *could* po na ba suggestion. Contraste na español, kote ba nuance bazali kosalema na subjonctif: 'Quizás el autor intentara...' ekoya 'The author might be trying...' to 'Perhaps the author is trying...'.
3. **Voix passive mpe passive na 'it'**: Po kopesa distance mpe objectivité (it is argued, it could be said). Na español, 'se' impersonal ezali ya courant, kasi na anglais bazali kotambola na passive.
4. **Présent historique**: Po kosala histoire ya ba événement ya intrigue (In Chapter 3, the protagonist meets...), tandi na español bazali kotambola na présent, kasi passé ezali ya courant na ba narration ya détaillé.
5. **Ba structure po kosalela but mpe cause**: *in order to, so as to, with the aim of* vs. 'para', mpe *due to, owing to* vs. 'debido a'.

concept_examples.text: The author's use of irony subtly undermines the protagonist's credibility.
concept_examples.translation: Kosalela ya ironie na ndenge ya auteur elongi na ndenge ya subtil crédibilité ya protagoniste.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ði ˈɔːθərz juːs əv ˈaɪrəni ˈsʌtli ˌʌndərˈmaɪnz ðə prəˈtæɡənɪsts ˌkredɪˈbɪləti/

concept_examples.text: One could argue that the novel's ending reflects a critique of consumerism.
concept_examples.translation: Tokoki koloba ete fin ya roman ezali critique na consumérisme.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wʌn kʊd ˈɑːrɡjuː ðæt ðə ˈnɒvlz ˈendɪŋ rɪˈflekts ə krɪˈtiːk əv kənˈsjuːmərɪzəm/

concept_examples.text: The poem's imagery evokes a sense of nostalgia for a lost past.
concept_examples.translation: Ba image ya poème bazali kosalela molɔngɔ ya nostalgie po na passé ya perdu.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈpoʊɪmz ˈɪmɪdʒəri ɪˈvoʊks ə sens əv nɒˈstældʒə fɔːr ə lɔːst pæst/

concept_examples.text: It is often said that García Márquez's works blend realism and fantasy seamlessly.
concept_examples.translation: Na général, bazali koloba ete ba œuvre ya García Márquez bazali kosalela réalisme mpe fantaisie na ndenge ya parfait.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈɒfn sed ðæt ˈɡɑːrsiə ˈmɑːrkɛsɪz wɜːrks blend rɪˈə lɪzəm ənd ˈfæntəsi ˈsiːmləsli/

common_error.wrong: The author use irony to criticize the society.
common_error.correct: The author uses irony to criticize society.
common_error.correct_alt: Through irony, the author critiques society.
common_error.explanation: Sɛkɔ ya mawa ezali kosuka '-s' ya troisième personne du singulier na présent simple ('use' na esika ya 'uses'). Na español, terminaison verbale ezali kosala changement, kasi na anglais ezali fixe. Mpe 'society' akoki kozala na déterminant soki tokolɔngɔ na société na général. Mpe tokoki kosuka structure 'use X to' na ba contexte ya analyse; tokoki kosalela 'employs' to 'deploys' po na précision ya mingi.

levels.label: Critical Vocabulary: Analyzing Style and Structure
levels.translation: Vocabulaire ya critique: analyse ya style mpe structure

examples.original: The narrative's fragmented structure mirrors the protagonist's psychological state.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈnærətɪvz fræɡˈmentɪd ˈstrʌktʃər ˈmɪrəz ðə prəˈtæɡənɪsts ˌsaɪkəˈlɒdʒɪkl steɪt/
examples.translation: Structure ya fragmenté ya narration ezali kosalela état psychologique ya protagoniste.
examples.note: Verbe 'mirror' ezali métaphorique mpe ya courant na analyse littéraire. Funda na kosalela yango na esika ya 'reflect' po na variété.

examples.original: The author's choice of diction evokes a formalitical tone, contrasting with the colloquial dialogue.
examples.phonetic: /ði ˈɔːθərz tʃɔɪs əv ˈdɪkʃən ɪˈvoʊks ə fɔːrˈmælɪtɪkl toʊn kənˈtræstɪŋ wɪð ðə kəˈloʊkwiəl ˈdaɪəlɒɡ/
examples.translation: Choix ya vocabulaire na ndenge ya auteur ezali kosalela ton ya formel, na contraste na dialogue ya courant.
examples.note: Tɛka na kosalela 'choice' mpe 'diction' na esika ya 'words'. Verbe 'evoke' ezali ya important.

examples.original: The metaphor of the journey underscores the character's quest for identity.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈmetəfər əv ðə ˈdʒɜːrni ˌʌndərˈskɔːrz ðə ˈkærɪktərz kwest fɔːr aɪˈdentəti/
examples.translation: Métaphore ya voyage ezali kosalela recherche ya identité ya personnage.
examples.note: Sala 'underscore' po na 'subrayar' na ba contexte ya académique; suka 'underline' ya courant na español.

levels.label: Modal Verbs for Interpretation and Deduction
levels.translation: Verbe modal po na interprétation mpe déduction

examples.original: The recurring imagery of darkness might symbolize the protagonist's inner conflict.
examples.phonetic: /ðə rɪˈkɜːrɪŋ ˈɪmɪdʒəri əv ˈdɑːrknəs maɪt ˈsɪmbəlaɪz ðə prəˈtæɡənɪsts ˈɪnər ˈkɒnflɪkt/
examples.translation: Ba image ya récurrent ya obscurité tokoki kosalela conflit interne ya protagoniste.
examples.note: Sala 'might' po na possibilité ya faible; 'may' ezali ya fort. Contraste na español 'podría'.

examples.original: The abrupt ending must be a deliberate choice to leave the reader unsettled.
examples.phonetic: /ði əˈbrʌpt ˈendɪŋ mʌst bi ə dɪˈlɪbərət tʃɔɪs tuː liːv ðə ˈriːdər ʌnˈsetld/
examples.translation: Fin ya brusque doit ezali choix ya délibéré po na kopesa lecteur molɔngɔ ya inquiet.
examples.note: 'Must be' po na déduction logique. Attention: na español 'debe ser' mpe na anglais bazali kosalela 'must' po na probabilité ya futur.

examples.original: The author could have intended the ambiguous dialogue to challenge the audience.
examples.phonetic: /ði ˈɔːθər kʊd hæv ɪnˈtendɪd ði æmˈbɪɡjuəs ˈdaɪəlɒɡ tuː ˈtʃælɪndʒ ði ˈɔːdiəns/
examples.translation: Auteur akoki akokaki na intention ya kopesa dialogue ya ambigu po na kosala défi na public.
examples.note: 'Could have + past participle' ezali kosalela possibilité ya passé ya réalisé. Ezali ya courant na ba critique.

levels.label: Passive and Impersonal Constructions for Objective Analysis
levels.translation: Ba construction ya passive mpe impersonnel po na analyse ya objectif

examples.original: It is widely acknowledged that the novel's style is heavily influenced by French surrealism.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈwaɪdli əkˈnɒlɪdʒd ðæt ðə ˈnɒvlz staɪl ɪz ˈhevɪli ˈɪnfluənst baɪ frentʃ səˈriːə lɪzəm/
examples.translation: Na général, bazali koloba ete style ya roman ezali na influence ya fort na surréalisme ya français.
examples.note: Na español bazali kosalela 'se reconoce' na 'se' impersonnel; na anglais tokoki kosalela passive 'It is + past participle'.

examples.original: The theme of isolation is explored through stream-of-consciousness narration.
examples.phonetic: /ðə θiːm əv ˌaɪsəˈleɪʃən ɪz ɪkˈsplɔːrd θruː striːm əv ˈkɒnʃəsnəs nəˈreɪʃən/
examples.translation: Thème ya isolement ezali kosalema na narration na flux ya conscience.
examples.note: Passive 'is explored' ezali ya formel mingi na 'the author explores'. Sala yango po na kopesa changement ya focalisation.

examples.original: It could be argued that the protagonist's passivity is a commentary on social apathy.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt kʊd bi ˈɑːrɡjuːd ðæt ðə prəˈtæɡənɪsts ˌpæsɪˈvɪti ɪz ə kəˈmentri ɒn ˈsoʊʃəl ˈæpəθi/
examples.translation: Tokoki koloba ete passivité ya protagoniste ezali commentaire na apathie ya social.
examples.note: Construction ya impersonnel ezali ya important po na essai ya académique. Na español, 'se podría argumentar' ezali kosalema na ndenge ya mot à mot, kasi na anglais bazali kosalela 'It could be argued'.

translations.ln: Analyse ya littéraire mpe culturel ya profond

title: The Art of Nuance: Hedging and Speculating / Mokili ya makasi: kozonga mpe koyekola
bridge: Na lingála, bato basili kokoma na nkombo ya kondicional mpe subjuntivo mpo na kozonga mpe koyekola (p.e., 'Mbala mosusu akoki kozala'). Na anglais, makasi ezali komonana na verbes modaux, adverbes mpe makasi malamu koleka 'may well', 'might as well' to 'I dare say'. Likambo mpé ya ntina ezali ete anglais azelaki na subjuntivo ya makasi, mpo na bato ya lingála bakoki kozala makasi koleka to koyoka 'maybe' na makasi. Ezali ya ntina mpo na koyeba makasi ya probabilité mpe evidencialité mpo na kozala na makasi ya makasi mpe ya makasi.
rule: Mpo na koyekola mpe kozonga na anglais C1, basili: 1) Verbes modaux ya probabilité (may, might, could, should, ought to) na makasi na bango ya certitude. 2) Makasi ya passé modal (might have, could have) mpo na koyekola likambo ya passé. 3) Adverbes mpe lokuta ya doute: arguably, presumably, allegedly, in all likelihood, by any stretch of the imagination. 4) Makasi ya kozonga (hedges) koleka 'I would venture to say', 'It stands to reason that', 'One might argue that'. 5) Inversion na 'should/were' mpo na hypothèse formelle. 6) Koyoka 'seem/appear' na suite ya infinitif to that-cláusula mpo na distance evidencial. Makasi ya ntina: basili kobomba subjuntivo; pozition ya adverbes ezali ya kozala na makasi kasi ezali na makasi; 'maybe' ezali ya kozala na makasi mpe ezali kozala na makasi ya makasi mpo na 'perhaps' to 'possibly'.

concept_examples.text: The implications of this argument might be more far-reaching than we initially assumed.
concept_examples.translation: Makasi ya proposition oyo ekoki kozala na makasi ya makasi koleka tozali koyeba na mbala ya ntinda.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə ˌɪmplɪˈkeɪʃənz əv ðɪs ˈɑːrɡjumənt maɪt bi mɔːr ˌfɑːrˈriːtʃɪŋ ðæn wi ɪˈnɪʃəli əˈsjuːmd/

concept_examples.text: One could argue that consciousness is merely a byproduct of neural activity.
concept_examples.translation: Tokoki koyeba ete conscience ezali kaka na mokili ya activité ya neuronale.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wʌn kʊd ˈɑːrɡjuː ðæt ˈkɑːnʃəsnəs ɪz ˈmɪrli ə ˈbaɪˌprɑːdʌkt əv ˈnjʊrəl ækˈtɪvəti/

concept_examples.text: It seems highly unlikely that free will exists in a deterministic universe.
concept_examples.translation: Ezali na makasi mpe ya kozala ete libre arbitre ezali na mokili ya déterministe.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪt siːmz ˈhaɪli ʌnˈlaɪkli ðæt friː wɪl ɪɡˈzɪsts ɪn ə dɪˌtɜːrmɪnˈɪstɪk ˈjuːnɪvɜːrs/

concept_examples.text: Had we considered the ethical dimensions, we might have reached a different conclusion.
concept_examples.translation: Soki tozali koyeba makasi ya éthique, tokoki kozala na conclusion mosusu.
concept_examples.phonetic: /hæd wi kənˈsɪdərd ði ˈeθɪkəl daɪˈmɛnʃənz, wi maɪt hæv riːtʃt ə ˈdɪfərənt kənˈkluːʒən/

common_error.wrong: Maybe the concept of truth is subjective.
common_error.correct: The concept of truth may be subjective.
common_error.correct_alt: Arguably, the concept of truth is subjective.
common_error.explanation: Likama ezali na kozonga 'quizás' na mbala ya ntinda ya proposition. Na anglais, 'maybe' ezali ya kozala na makasi mpe, na contexte académique to philosophique, basili 'may' (modal) to adverbes koleka 'arguably' to 'presumably' mpo na makasi ya makasi. Mpé, kozonga 'maybe' na mbala ya ntinda ekoki kozala na makasi ya makasi; na C1, basili makasi ya makasi ya modalité.

examples.original: Philosophers may differ on this point, but the consensus is shifting.
examples.phonetic: /fɪˈlɑːsəfərz meɪ ˈdɪfər ɑːn ðɪs pɔɪnt, bʌt ðə kənˈsɛnsəs ɪz ˈʃɪftɪŋ/
examples.translation: Bafilosope bakoki kozala na makasi ya mosusu na point oyo, kasi consensus ezali kozala na makasi.
examples.note: Koyoka 'may' mpo na possibilité ya présent. Koyeba ete na lingála basili subjuntivo ('puede que difieran'), kasi na anglais basili 'may' + infinitif na sujet.

examples.original: This theory could explain several paradoxes that have puzzled scientists for decades.
examples.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈθɪri kʊd ɪkˈspleɪn ˈsɛvrəl ˈpærədɑːksɪz ðæt hæv ˈpʌzəld ˈsaɪəntɪsts fɔːr dɪˈkeɪdz/
examples.translation: Théorie oyo ekoki kozala na explication mpo na paradoxes mingi ya kozala na bato ya science na buka ya buka.
examples.note: 'Could' ezali mpo na possibilité ya kondicional. Koyeba ete ezali kozala na 'podía' kasi 'podría'.

examples.original: The author might have intended a hidden critique of capitalism.
examples.phonetic: /ði ˈɔːθər maɪt hæv ɪnˈtɛndɪd ə ˈhɪdən krɪˈtiːk əv ˈkæpɪtəlɪzəm/
examples.translation: Auteur akoki kozala na intention ya kozala na critique ya kozala na kapitalisme.
examples.note: Passé modal 'might have + participio' mpo na koyekola likambo ya passé. Na lingála basili kondicional ya composé, kasi na anglais ezali ya ntina 'have'.

levels.label: Evidentiality and Reporting
levels.translation: Evidencialité mpe discours ya kozala na bato

examples.original: The philosopher allegedly asserted that reality is a construct.
examples.phonetic: /ðə fɪˈlɑːsəfər əˈlɛdʒɪdli əˈsɜːrtɪd ðæt riˈæləti ɪz ə ˈkɑːnstrʌkt/
examples.translation: Bafilosope bazali koyeba ete réalité ezali na mokili.
examples.note: 'Allegedly' ezali mpo na kozala ete moyebi azali kozala na vérité. Na lingála basili 'supuestamente', kasi na anglais ezali ya kozala na discours formelle.

examples.original: It is widely believed that consciousness emerges from complexity.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈwaɪdli bɪˈliːvd ðæt ˈkɑːnʃəsnəs ɪˈmɜːrdʒɪz frəm kəmˈplɛksəti/
examples.translation: Bato mingi bazali koyeba ete conscience ezali na mokili ya complexité.
examples.note: Structure passive na 'it is + participio + that' mpo na kozala na distance na proposition. Na lingála basili 'se cree', kasi na anglais ezali ya kozala na passive impersonnelle.

examples.original: The results seem to contradict the initial hypothesis.
examples.phonetic: /ðə rɪˈzʌlts siːm tə ˌkɑːntrəˈdɪkt ði ɪˈnɪʃəl haɪˈpɑːθəsɪs/
examples.translation: Résultat ezali kozala na contradiction na hypothèse ya ntinda.
examples.note: Koyoka 'seem + infinitif' mpo na kozala na apparence, kaka certitude. Na lingála basili 'parece que', kasi na anglais basili structure oyo na infinitif.

examples.original: I would venture to say that moral relativism has its limits.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd ˈvɛntʃər tə seɪ ðæt ˈmɔːrəl ˈrɛlətɪvɪzəm hæz ɪts ˈlɪmɪts/
examples.translation: Nazali koyeba ete relativisme moral ezali na makasi ya kozala na limite.
examples.note: Structure ya kozala na politesse mpe formelle mpo na kozonga opinion ya ngaï. Na lingála basili kondicional ('diría'), kasi anglais azali koyoka 'venture to' mpo na makasi ya audace.

examples.original: It stands to reason that free will and determinism cannot coexist.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt stændz tə ˈriːzən ðæt friː wɪl ənd dɪˈtɜːrmɪnɪzəm ˈkænɒt ˌkoʊɪɡˈzɪst/
examples.translation: Ezali ya kozala ete libre arbitre mpe déterminisme basali kozala na mokili.
examples.note: Lokuta mpo na kozala na conclusion ya logique. Na lingála basili 'es razonable pensar que', kasi lokuta oyo ezali ya kozala na anglais.

examples.original: Were we to accept this premise, the argument would collapse.
examples.phonetic: /wɜːr wi tə əkˈsɛpt ðɪs ˈprɛmɪs, ði ˈɑːrɡjumənt wʊd kəˈlæps/
examples.translation: Soki tozali koyoka proposition oyo, argument ekoki kozala na makasi.
examples.note: Inversion ya kondicional formelle na 'were' + infinitif. Ezali koleka imperfecto ya subjuntivo na lingála ('si aceptáramos'), kasi ezali kaka na registre ya makasi.

title: Nuanced Political Commentary / Komentɛ́lɛ ya politikɛ́ na makásí
bridge: Na español, tokosala na mpo na makásí na mpo na makásí mpe na mpo na makásí mpo na kosala na mpo na makásí. Na anglais, basangana na mpo na makásí mpe na mpo na makásí mpo na kosala na mpo na makásí. Boye mpe na mpo na makásí mpo na kosala na mpo na makásí, mpe na mpo na makásí mpo na kosala na mpo na makásí. Na anglais, makásí mpe makásí ya makásí (utterly, profoundly, slightly) ezali na makásí mpe na makásí, mpe na español tokosala na mpo na makásí mpe na mpo na makásí.
rule: Mpo na komentɛ́lɛ ya politikɛ́ ya makásí (C1), tokosala: 1) Verbes modaux ya déduction mpe possibilité: 'might', 'could', 'may', 'should' (p.ex., 'The policy might backfire'). 2) Structures passives impersonnelles na 'it' + verbes ya opinion: 'it is argued', 'it has been suggested', 'it is widely believed'. 3) Adjectifs ya degré mpe ya valeur: 'profound', 'utterly', 'deeply', 'marginally'. 4) Connecteurs discursifs ya contraste mpe concession: 'while', 'whereas', 'even though'. 5) Constructions na 'tend to' mpo na généralisations. Boya kozala na mpo na 'I think'; sala na mpo na 'I would argue', 'It seems to me'. Boye mpe na mpo na anglais formel, tokoki kozala na mpo na subjonctif (excepté na expressions fixes comme 'suffice it to say') mpe tokosala na mpo na 'should' to indicatif.

concept_examples.text: The government's approach to immigration could be described as profoundly misguided.
concept_examples.translation: Mbongo ya gouvernement na immigration ekoki kozala na nguya ya erreur ya makásí.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈɡʌvənmənts əˈproʊtʃ tə ˌɪmɪˈɡreɪʃən kʊd bi dɪˈskraɪbd æz prəˈfaʊndli ˌmɪsˈɡaɪdɪd/

concept_examples.text: It is widely argued that economic sanctions rarely achieve their intended objectives.
concept_examples.translation: Ezali na molɔngɔ́ni ya makásí ete sanctions économiques epesaka na makásí mpo na kozala na makásí ya makásí.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈwaɪdli ˈɑːrɡjuːd ðæt ˌiːkəˈnɑːmɪk ˈsæŋkʃənz ˈrerli əˈtʃiːv ðeər ɪnˈtendɪd əbˈdʒektɪvz/

concept_examples.text: While the reform has brought some benefits, it has also exacerbated social inequality.
concept_examples.translation: Ata reforma ezali na makásí, kasi ezali mpe na makásí ya makásí ya inégalité sociale.
concept_examples.phonetic: /waɪl ðə rɪˈfɔːrm hæz brɔːt sʌm ˈbenɪfɪts, ɪt hæz ˈɔːlsoʊ ɪɡˈzæsərbeɪtɪd ˈsoʊʃəl ˌɪnɪˈkwɑːləti/

concept_examples.text: The rhetoric of populism tends to oversimplify complex economic realities.
concept_examples.translation: Rhétorique ya populisme ezali na makásí mpo na kosala na makásí ya réalité économique ya makásí.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈretərɪk əv ˈpɑːpjəlɪzəm tendz tə ˌoʊvərˈsɪmplɪfaɪ ˈkɑːmpleks ˌiːkəˈnɑːmɪk riˈælətiz/

common_error.wrong: It is probable that the new law will cause more problems.
common_error.correct: The new law is likely to cause more problems.
common_error.correct_alt: The new law could well cause more problems.
common_error.explanation: Traduction littérale ya 'es probable que' na 'it is probable that' ezali ya bon, kasi ezali na nguya ya kozala na makásí na anglais formel. Baoto ya langue basangana na 'be likely to' to 'could well' mpo na kosala probabilité na makásí. Structure 'it is probable that' ezali mpo na contexte ya makásí to académique, kasi na conversation ya politikɛ́ basala na constructions ya makásí.

examples.original: The prime minister's decision might be seen as a concession to hardliners.
examples.phonetic: /ðə praɪm ˈmɪnɪstərz dɪˈsɪʒən maɪt bi siːn æz ə kənˈseʃən tə ˈhɑːrdlaɪnərz/
examples.translation: Décision ya Premier Ministre ekoki kozala na nguya ya concession na ba radicaux.
examples.note: Sala na 'might' mpo na possibilité spéculative, na makásí ya 'could'.

examples.original: The negotiations could easily break down over the issue of border control.
examples.phonetic: /ðə nɪˌɡoʊʃiˈeɪʃənz kʊd ˈiːzəli breɪk daʊn ˈoʊvər ðə ˈɪʃuː əv ˈbɔːrdər kənˈtroʊl/
examples.translation: Négociations ekoki kozala na makásí ya kozala na problème ya contrôle ya frontière.
examples.note: 'could easily' ezali na probabilité ya makásí ya 'might'.

examples.original: This policy will inevitably lead to a rise in unemployment.
examples.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈpɑːləsi wɪl ɪnˈevɪtəbli liːd tə ə raɪz ɪn ˌʌnɪmˈplɔɪmənt/
examples.translation: Politique oyo ekokí kosala na augmentation ya chômage.
examples.note: 'will inevitably' ezali na certitude na accent sur négatif.

examples.original: It may well be that the opposition will gain ground in the next election.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt meɪ wel bi ðæt ðə ˌɑːpəˈzɪʃən wɪl ɡeɪn ɡraʊnd ɪn ðə nekst ɪˈlekʃən/
examples.translation: Ekoki kozala na makásí ete opposition ekokí kozala na terrain na élections ya liboso.
examples.note: 'may well be' ezali modisme mpo na probabilité ya makásí. Normalement, tokosala 'well' entre 'may' mpe 'be'.

examples.original: While the tax cuts have stimulated growth, they have also widened the fiscal deficit.
examples.phonetic: /waɪl ðə tæks kʌts hæv ˈstɪmjʊleɪtɪd ɡroʊθ, ðeɪ hæv ˈɔːlsoʊ ˈwaɪdənd ðə ˈfɪskəl ˈdefɪsɪt/
examples.translation: Ata coupures ya impôts esalisaki croissance, kasi esalisaki mpe déficit fiscal.
examples.note: Sala na 'while' na liboso mpo na kosala contraste (ezali na nguya ya 'aunque' kasi na makásí).

examples.original: The reform has its merits, yet it fails to address the root causes of corruption.
examples.phonetic: /ðə rɪˈfɔːrm hæz ɪts ˈmerɪts, jet ɪt feɪlz tə əˈdres ðə ruːt ˈkɔːzəz əv kəˈrʌpʃən/
examples.translation: Réforme ezali na makásí, kasi ezali na problème ya corruption.
examples.note: 'yet' ezali conjonction adversative mpo na kosala pause, ezali na nguya ya 'sin embargo'.

examples.original: Despite the government's promises, public trust remains low.
examples.phonetic: /dɪˈspaɪt ðə ˈɡʌvərnmənts ˈprɑːmɪsɪz, ˈpʌblɪk trʌst rɪˈmeɪnz loʊ/
examples.translation: Ata promesses ya gouvernement, confiance ya peuple ezali na basenge.
examples.note: Sala na 'despite' + nom (boya 'despite of'). Alternance: 'In spite of'.

examples.original: However appealing the proposal sounds, it is economically unviable.
examples.phonetic: /haʊˈevər əˈpiːlɪŋ ðə prəˈpoʊzəl saʊndz, ɪt ɪz ˌiːkəˈnɑːmɪkəli ʌnˈvaɪəbəl/
examples.translation: Ata proposition ezali ya bon, ezali na problème ya économie.
examples.note: Construction 'However + adjective' mpo na concession ya makásí (ezali na nguya ya 'por muy... que').

examples.original: The bill's language is deliberately vague, leaving room for arbitrary interpretation.
examples.phonetic: /ðə bɪlz ˈlæŋɡwɪdʒ ɪz dɪˈlɪbərətli veɪɡ, ˈliːvɪŋ ruːm fɔːr ˈɑːrbɪtreri ɪnˌtɜːrprɪˈteɪʃən/
examples.translation: Langue ya projet de loi ezali na makásí, mpo na kosala interprétation ya makásí.
examples.note: Sala na adverbes ya manière ('deliberately') mpo na kosala intention ya critique.

examples.original: The opposition's rhetoric borders on xenophobia, albeit more subtly than before.
examples.phonetic: /ði ˌɑːpəˈzɪʃənz ˈretərɪk ˈbɔːrdərz ɒn ˌzenəˈfoʊbiə, ɔːlˈbiːɪt mɔːr ˈsʌtli ðæn bɪˈfɔːr/
examples.translation: Rhétorique ya opposition ezali na makásí ya xenophobie, ata na manière ya makásí.
examples.note: 'borders on' ezali figure ya rhétorique; 'albeit' ezali concessif formel (ata) mpo na kosala makásí.

examples.original: The minister's statement is a blatant attempt to scapegoat immigrants for economic woes.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈmɪnɪstərz ˈsteɪtmənt ɪz ə ˈbleɪtənt əˈtempt tə ˈskeɪpɡoʊt ˈɪmɪɡrənts fɔːr ˌiːkəˈnɑːmɪk woʊz/
examples.translation: Déclaration ya ministre ezali tentative ya makásí mpo na kosala ba immigrants na problème ya économie.
examples.note: Sala na 'blatant' (descarado) mpe verbe 'scapegoat' (kosala quelqu'un na problème).

examples.original: This is a classic case of political grandstanding, which undermines genuine debate.
examples.phonetic: /ðɪs ɪz ə ˈklæsɪk keɪs əv pəˈlɪtɪkəl ˈɡrændstændɪŋ, wɪtʃ ˌʌndərˈmaɪnz ˈdʒenjuɪn dɪˈbeɪt/
examples.translation: Oyo ezali exemple ya makásí ya demagogie politique, mpo na kosala débat ya makásí.
examples.note: 'grandstanding' ezali nom (demagogie na sens négatif). Sala na 'which' mpo na kosala critique.

title: Narratives with Perspective / Makambo oyo elobeli ndinga
bridge: Na espanyol, mpo na kosala etezo oyo elobeli ndinga ya lokola, tozali kozinga mbala mosusuni mpo na makambo oyo ezali na ntina na mbala mosukoli mpo na makambo oyo ezali na ntina, tokoki kozinga mbala mibali na bosembo. Na anglais, esengo etali mbala mosukoli na mbala mosusuni ezali ya ndenge mpe, kasi kozinga mbala mosukoli mpo na komona ete nini ezali liboso ezali ya motuya mingi na ezali ya koboma na espanyol, wapi tozali kozinga mbala mosukoli mpo na makambo oyo ezali na ntina na kati ya makambo oyo ezali na ntina. Mpe, anglais ezali kozinga mbala mosukoli mpo na komona ete nini ezali liboso mpo na koloba ete makambo ezali na ntina, oyo ezali na espanyol ezali kosala na lokuta oyo ezali na ntina. Basali ya espanyol bazali na botiki kozinga mbala mosukoli wapi anglais ezali na bozua mbala mosukoli, mpe na kosala ete makambo ezali na ntina.
rule: Mpo na kosala etezo oyo ezali na ntina na anglais (CEFR C1), tozali kozinga mbala mibali mpo na kosala ete makambo ezali na ntina na ntango nyonso na koloba ete nini ezali na ntina. Mbala mosukoli (p.e., 'she arrived') ezali koloba makambo oyo ezali na ntina na ntango nyonso. Mbala mosusuni (p.e., 'she was arriving') ezali koloba makambo oyo ezali na ntina na ntango nyonso, mpo na kosala ete makambo ezali na ntina. Mbala mosukoli (p.e., 'she had arrived') ezali koloba ete makambo ezali na ntina liboso ya makambo mosusu oyo ezali na ntina, mpe ezali ya motuya mingi tango ntango ezali na ntina. Mbala mosukoli (p.e., 'she had been arriving') ezali koloba ete makambo ezali na ntina liboso ya makambo mosusu oyo ezali na ntina. Mpo na koloba ete nini ezali na ntina (mitema, makasi, makambo oyo ezali na ntina to etezo oyo ezali na ntina), tozali kozinga 'would' mpo na makambo oyo ezali na ntina, 'used to' mpo na makambo oyo ezali na ntina, mpe makambo oyo ezali na ntina mpo na koloba ete nini ezali na ntina. Ezali ya motuya mingi te kozinga na ndenge ya espanyol: mbala mosusuni oyo ezali na ntina ezali kozinga mbala mosusuni (mbala mosusuni ezali 'used to'), mpe mbala mosukoli ezali kozinga mbala mosukoli to tango ntango ezali na ntina.

concept_examples.text: I had already left the office when she called, so I missed her message.
concept_examples.translation: Nazali na kosala na bureau tango azalaki kosenga, mpo na naleki kosilisa ye.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ hæd ɔːlˈrɛdi lɛft ði ˈɒfɪs wɛn ʃiː kɔːld, səʊ aɪ mɪst hɜː ˈmɛsɪdʒ/

concept_examples.text: She was reading the report for hours, and she still didn't notice the mistake.
concept_examples.translation: Azalaki kosala rapport mpo na hora mingi, mpe mpe azali te na mona likolo.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiː wɒz ˈriːdɪŋ ðə rɪˈpɔːt fə ˈaʊəz, ənd ʃiː stɪl ˈdɪdnt ˈnəʊtɪs ðə mɪsˈteɪk/

concept_examples.text: By the time we arrived, the train had already left; we had been stuck in traffic for two hours.
concept_examples.translation: Tango tokoki, train azalaki kokende; tokoki kozala na ntango mibali na nzete mpo na hora mibali.
concept_examples.phonetic: /baɪ ðə taɪm wiː əˈraɪvd, ðə treɪn hæd ɔːlˈrɛdi lɛft; wiː hæd biːn stʌk ɪn ˈtræfɪk fə tuː ˈaʊəz/

concept_examples.text: He used to live in Madrid, but he would often travel to Barcelona for work.
concept_examples.translation: Nazalaki na kolala na Madrid, kasi nazalaki na koyebana na Barcelona mpo na kosala.
concept_examples.phonetic: /hiː juːst tə lɪv ɪn məˈdrɪd, bʌt hiː wʊd ˈɒfən ˈtrævl tə ˌbɑːsəˈloʊnə fə wɜːk/

common_error.wrong: I was already leaving the office when she called, so I missed her message.
common_error.correct: I had already left the office when she called, so I missed her message.
common_error.correct_alt: I had already been leaving the office when she called (less natural).
common_error.explanation: Likolo ezali mpo na espanyol tozali kozinga mbala mosusuni ('salía') mpo na makambo oyo ezali na ntina oyo ezali na ntina. Na anglais, tango makambo ezali na ntina liboso ya makambo mosusu oyo ezali na ntina, tozali kozinga mbala mosukoli ('had left'). Mbala mosusuni ('was leaving') ezali koloba ete azalaki na ntango ya kosala, te ete azalaki na ntina. Mpo na kozala na likolo, kanisa ete makambo ezali na ntina to ezali na ntina na ntango nyonso. Tango makambo ezali na ntina liboso ya makambo mosusu oyo ezali na ntina, kozinga mbala mosukoli.

levels.label: Narrative Tenses: Sequence and Background
levels.translation: Mbala ya etezo: esika na mbala

examples.original: When I entered the room, she was writing a letter and the radio was playing softly.
examples.phonetic: /wɛn aɪ ˈɛntəd ðə ruːm, ʃiː wɒz ˈraɪtɪŋ ə ˈlɛtər ənd ðə ˈreɪdiəʊ wɒz ˈpleɪɪŋ ˈsɒftli/
examples.translation: Tango nalaki na salle, azalaki kosala toli mpe radio azalaki kosala na bosembo.
examples.note: Kozinga mbala mosukoli mpo na makambo oyo ezali na ntina (entered) mpe mbala mosusuni mpo na makambo oyo ezali na ntina (was writing, was playing).

examples.original: We were walking home when it started to rain, so we took shelter under a tree.
examples.phonetic: /wiː wɜː ˈwɔːkɪŋ həʊm wɛn ɪt ˈstɑːtɪd tə reɪn, səʊ wiː tʊk ˈʃɛltər ˈʌndər ə triː/
examples.translation: Tokoki na nzete tango mbola kozala, mpo na naleki kozala na ntango mibali na nzete.
examples.note: Na espanyol, 'caminábamos' (mbala mosusuni) tozali kozinga mbala mosusuni na anglais mpo na mbala, mpe 'empezó' (mbala mosukoli) tozali kozinga mbala mosukoli.

examples.original: She had finished the report before the meeting started.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː hæd ˈfɪnɪʃt ðə rɪˈpɔːt bɪˈfɔː ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ ˈstɑːtɪd/
examples.translation: Azalaki na ntina ya rapport liboso ya ntango ya kosala.
examples.note: Mbala mosukoli ezali koloba ete nini ezali liboso. Na espanyol, tozali kozinga 'había terminado' to mpe 'terminó' tango ntango ezali na ntina, kasi na anglais 'had finished' ezali ya motuya mingi.

levels.label: Past Perfect and Past Perfect Continuous

examples.original: He had been working at that company for ten years before he decided to quit.
examples.phonetic: /hiː hæd biːn ˈwɜːkɪŋ æt ðæt ˈkʌmpəni fə tɛn jɪəz bɪˈfɔː hiː dɪˈsaɪdɪd tə kwɪt/
examples.translation: Nazalaki na kosala na entreprise oyo mpo na zomi mpo na kozala na ntina ya kozala na ntina.
examples.note: Mbala mosukoli ezali koloba ete nini ezali na ntina. Na espanyol, 'había estado trabajando' ezali ya ntina, kasi tozali kozinga 'llevaba diez años trabajando'.

examples.original: They had just arrived when the news broke.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ hæd dʒʌst əˈraɪvd wɛn ðə njuːz brəʊk/
examples.translation: Bazalaki na ntina tango mbola kozala.
examples.note: Lokuta 'just' na mbala mosukoli ezali koloba ete nini ezali na ntina. Na espanyol, tozali kozinga 'acabar de' na mbala mosusuni ('acababan de llegar'), kasi na anglais tozali kozinga 'had just arrived'.

examples.original: She was exhausted because she had been studying all night.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː wɒz ɪɡˈzɔːstɪd bɪˈkɒz ʃiː hæd biːn ˈstʌdiɪŋ ɔːl naɪt/
examples.translation: Nazalaki na ntina mpo na nazalaki na kosala na ye mpo na ye mpe mpo na ye.
examples.note: Mpo (had been studying) ezali koloba ete nini ezali na ntina (was exhausted). Mbala mosukoli ezali koloba ete nini ezali na ntina.

levels.label: Habits and Speculation in the Past
levels.translation: Makambo oyo ezali na ntina na makambo oyo ezali na ntina

examples.original: When I was a child, I would spend every summer at my grandparents' house.
examples.phonetic: /wɛn aɪ wɒz ə tʃaɪld, aɪ wʊd spɛnd ˈɛvri ˈsʌmər æt maɪ ˈɡrænˌpeərənts haʊs/
examples.translation: Tango nazalaki na koki, nazalaki na kolala na ntango nyonso na ntango ya bazoba na ngai.
examples.note: 'Would' tozali kozinga mpo na makambo oyo ezali na ntina, kasi te mpo na makambo oyo ezali na ntina. Tokoki kozinga 'I would live there' (tango ezali na ntina), kasi 'I used to live there'.

examples.original: He might have forgotten about the meeting; he's usually on time.
examples.phonetic: /hiː maɪt hæv fəˈɡɒtən əˈbaʊt ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ; hiːz ˈjuːʒuəli ɒn taɪm/
examples.translation: Tokoki kozala na ntina ya ntango; ntango nyonso ezali na ntina.
examples.note: Kozinga 'might have + participio' mpo na koloba ete nini ezali na ntina. Na espanyol, 'podría haber' to 'quizás olvidó'.

examples.original: She used to hate coffee, but now she loves it.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː juːst tə heɪt ˈkɒfi, bʌt naʊ ʃiː lʌvz ɪt/
examples.translation: Nazalaki na kosala café, kasi mpo na ye azali na ye.
examples.note: 'Used to' ezali koloba ete nini ezali na ntina to ete nini ezali na ntina. Ezali ya motuya mingi mpo na kosala ete nini ezali na ntina na ntango nyonso. Kozinga 'would' wapi mpo na ete ezali na ntina, te mpo na makambo oyo ezali na ntina.

translations.ln: Makambo oyo elobeli ndinga oyo ezali na ntina
